description: Creates a showcase: an embeddable photo/video gallery the client can update from their phone. Use it when the user wants a gallery, portfolio, project photos, or a section the client can update themselves. Requires a site id from list_sites or create_site. Only call after showing the plan to the user and getting explicit confirmation. Use type: "projects" for a portfolio where each project gets its own page, photos, and details (then create_project for each); the type can't change once the showcase has items. Turn on showCategoryFilters when items or projects will be grouped into categories. Safe to retry with the same arguments.

gridFit.description: cover crops grid tiles; contain letterboxes them to show the whole item, e.g. "cover".

pageSize.description: Items per "Load more" page (3–100), or null to show everything, e.g. 12.

showCategoryFilters.description: Show category filter tabs above the items, e.g. true when items are grouped into categories.

siteId.description: Client site id from list_sites or create_site, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

type.description: gallery (default: one set of photos and videos) or projects (a portfolio of projects, each with its own page, photos, description, and details), e.g. "projects".

name: create_showcase
title: Create showcase
